enable_html_rendering.description: Enable HTML mail rendering using WebKit (required for fancy plugin)

max_image_size.description: Maximum size (KB) for inline image display; 0 means unlimited

load_remote_images.description: Automatically load remote images in HTML messages (security-sensitive)

enable_javascript.description: Enable JavaScript execution in HTML messages (strongly discouraged)

load_plugins.description: Enable loading of plugins at startup (required for fancy.so)

plugins_list.description: List of plugin filenames to load; 'fancy.so' is the core plugin binary
